description: This dataset provides 40,000 RGB concrete-surface crops for binary crack classification. Özgenel collected photographs from buildings on the METU campus and generated 20,000 positive and 20,000 negative 227 by 227 pixel images from 458 originals measuring 4032 by 3024 pixels. Surface finish and illumination vary, and the provider reports no rotation or flipping augmentation. Coverage is campus buildings, with no stated acquisition dates; version 1 was published on 15 January 2018. Mendeley offers public download access under free CC BY 4.0 terms. A limitation is that many crops share source photographs, so crop-level splitting may not represent independent building-level validation. Binary surface labels also do not measure structural strength or crack depth. Simulation uses include testing observation error in building-condition inspection models. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository with built-asset surface evidence. The cited road-crack paper supplies the generation method, not establishing that these images depict roads. No images were downloaded.
